build.name: system packages for Go (curl, gcc for cgo and -race, make)
build.run: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl gcc libc6-dev make && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

build.name: Go 1.27.2 toolchain, checked against go.dev's sha256
build.run:
set -eu
version=go1.27.2
case "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" in
  amd64) arch=amd64; sum=ecbadb99091a3f46e31f5f934b068b1864eafa7995211b39eaddf76996045fe5 ;;
  arm64) arch=arm64; sum=94f3e30b8e374bc285e7dadc11e0865726b9bc6e85b841ccceaabc0214c6b7c8 ;;
  *) echo "no Go build for $(dpkg --print-architecture)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/go.tar.gz "https://go.dev/dl/$version.linux-$arch.tar.gz"
echo "$sum  /tmp/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -C /usr/local -xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz
rm /tmp/go.tar.gz
ln -s /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt /usr/local/bin/
test "$(go env GOVERSION)" = "$version"

build.name: gopls v0.23.0
build.run: GOBIN=/usr/local/bin GOPATH=/tmp/gopath GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@v0.23.0 && rm -rf /tmp/gopath /tmp/gocache && gopls version

startup.name: trust the mounted workspace for git
